releases.notes:
### Fixed

- **Switching between light and dark** (in System Settings, or with Auto at sunset) left the
  panel a washed-out grey until Blok was restarted. It follows the switch now. Its glass is no
  longer tinted for this: how see-through it is follows System Settings ▸ Appearance ▸ Liquid
  Glass.
- **Pasting screenshots into a note you're editing** adds them to that note, as dropping them on
  it does. ⌘V did nothing there before.
- **"Nothing here yet"** in an empty section no longer shows through the section's header when
  you scroll.

### Changed

- **Opening Blok** puts you in the input with nothing else selected, instead of leaving the last
  selected note lit up too. ↑ goes back to what you had selected when you hid Blok, so you can
  carry on down the list.

### Fixed

- **"Nothing selected"** came out of the notch even with notch confirmations turned off (Settings ▸
  Advanced ▸ Experimental). Every message now follows the setting.

### New

- **Free through your school or work?** Settings ▸ General ▸ Licence has a link to check whether a
  school, university or nonprofit you're at gives you Blok for free. If it does, the key comes by
  email, with a link that opens Blok to use it.

### Changed

- **⌘/ opens Settings ▸ Shortcuts**, where every shortcut is in a table to search and change, with
  the editor's keys (↩, /, ⌘B…) under While typing. The cheat sheet in the panel didn't fit.
- **Section headers sit closer together** again, as before the chevron's bigger click target.

### Fixed

- **Free licences from rosok.dev work.** Blok turned down keys from the website as "not a Blok
  licence key".
- **Hiding Blok while editing a note** threw the edit away; it's saved now, as clicking elsewhere
  does. Esc still drops it.
- **A private note stays short while it's blurred**, instead of growing to its full length when
  selected and showing how long it is.
- **A section's header** no longer stays lit up after notes are dropped into it.

### New

- **A licence can be activated from a link.** Opening the link in the licence email opens Blok,
  which says whose licence it is and asks before using it, so there's no key to copy and paste. A
  link that was cut short says so, with Open Settings to paste the key instead.

### Changed

- **Deleting a section** happens straight away, with Undo in the message (and ⌘Z), instead of
  asking first. Undo puts it back where it was, with its notes and images.
- **A section's right-click menu is in groups:** Capture Here, Rename… · Collapse, Sort by Tag,
  Move · Copy as Prompt, Export as Markdown… · Make Private, Hide · Delete Section.
- **Dragging notes onto a section's header** lights it up and puts them at the top of that section.
  Resting over a folded section opens it, as a Finder folder does.

### Changed

- **The list's scroll bar works like the Mac's own.** It follows Show scroll bars in System
  Settings ▸ Appearance: while scrolling it's a thin bar that widens when you point at it (and
  stays while you do), and with Always (or a mouse with Automatically) it's there all the time,
  full width on its track, with room of its own. Drag it, or click its track to jump there. It
  moves at the list's own speed, is as long as the part you can see, and reaches the top and
  bottom exactly with the list.

### Fixed

- **A note half under a pinned section header** turned white (black in dark mode) until it
  scrolled out from under it.

### New

- **A haptic tick** on a Force Touch trackpad each time a note or section you're dragging finds
  a new place.
- **The Accessibility banner can be closed.** Settings ▸ General now has an Accessibility row:
  whether it's allowed, a button to allow it, and a switch to bring the banner back.

### Changed

- **The section picker under the input is a bigger button**, lit up on hover, and anywhere on it
  opens the menu.
- **Clicking a section's header selects it**, as the arrow keys do, and its chevron is easier to
  hit.
- **Deleting the completed notes** happens straight away, with Undo in the message, instead of
  asking first.
- **Menus:** what doesn't apply is left out of a right-click menu instead of greyed out, the …
  menu shows its shortcuts in their own column, and the menu bar menu starts with Enable
  Accessibility… when it's needed. Help in the panel, the Welcome window and the menu bar icon
  names the shortcuts you've set, not the defaults.
- **Restore Defaults…** in Settings ▸ Shortcuts asks first.
- **Small text sizes** keep text at 10 points or more, and a note's copy button grows with the
  text.
- **VoiceOver** reads images and files by name, as buttons that copy them (with Open and Show in
  Finder), says what each ✕ removes, and says which section ↑↓ reach in ⌘K.

### Fixed

- **Checking off a note** with completed notes hidden left nothing selected: the note above it
  (or its section's header) is selected now.
- **↑↓ in ⌘K** went past the bottom of a long list without scrolling, and a pointer resting on the
  list took the highlight back.
- **Dragging a section** with the list scrolled down hid the other sections, and a small drag
  could send it to the end: they stay around the pointer now.
- **The menu bar menu** said Show Blok and Hide Blok in English whatever the language.
- **The capture confirmation by the notch** has an easier-to-read page line.

### New

- **A licence key can be turned off** if it's been shared around: Blok hears of it with its daily
  update check, and a key that's been turned off pauses capture and new notes, as the end of the
  trial does, and says so. Your notes stay, as always.

### Fixed

- **Drag and drop on macOS 26:** dropping files and images on Blok, and dragging notes and
  sections, did nothing there, and dragging a section could leave every section folded. They
  work now, and a section let go anywhere but the list always unfolds again.

**A licence from this version on:** Blok is free to try for 14 days, starting when you first open
this version. After that, capture and new notes need a licence key (Settings ▸ General ▸ Licence);
without one, every note is still there to read, copy, export and check off. Using Blok already?
Your key comes by email.

### New

- **Private notes:** make a note (or a whole section) private from its menu, and it's blurred
  until you click it, shown after Touch ID, and never sent to an AI agent. A note that looks like
  it holds a secret (an API key, a password, a pasted environment file) becomes private by
  itself; Settings ▸ General can switch that off, and the settings file takes your own patterns.
  Which notes are private syncs between your Macs once they all have this version.
- **Blok in Norwegian:** everything Blok says is in English and Norsk bokmål. Settings ▸ General ▸
  Language picks one, or the Mac's language.
- **VoiceOver:** each note reads as its text and state, with actions for what dragging and its
  menu do (done, edit, copy, pin, move, delete); section headers are headings. Messages are read
  out. With Reduce motion on, nothing in the panel slides or springs.
- **Connect an AI Agent** (in the … menu): the setup for Claude Code, Codex, the Claude app,
  Cursor and others, ready to copy. A note an agent adds or changes carries its own name.
- **Sync in one step:** Settings ▸ Sync has a single **Set Up Sync…**: choose the folder, and Blok
  joins the library another Mac syncs there, or starts one.
- **Compact layout** (Settings ▸ General): a denser list and a one-line input at any size.
- **Dragging a section** folds every section to its header while you drag, and the others slide
  aside where it will land, as notes do.
- **Keys for sections:** ⌥↑ and ⌥↓ on a section's header move it, and ⌫ deletes it.
- **Resizing with the keyboard:** ⌃⌥⌘ + the arrows move the panel's free edge.
- **Export a section** on its own from its menu; … ▸ Export Library as Markdown… exports them all.
- **⌘⇧.** shows or hides completed notes.
- **Return can add a line** instead of saving (Settings ▸ General ▸ Return), and ↩ confirms a
  delete.
- The panel opens on the screen of the app you're in.

### Changed

- The position bar is always there while you scroll; its setting is gone.
- After adding a note, ↑ starts from it; the composer's section picker is easier to hit; Settings
  is a little lower.

### Fixed

- The / menu shows while editing a note.
- ⌘Z brings back a note you checked off with its circle.
- Editing a note that isn't private no longer asks for Touch ID.
- The + button's file dialog opens at once, and dialogs don't darken the panel.
- The panel no longer goes dark for a moment when Settings closes.
- ⇧⇧ captures from a terminal with VoiceOver on.
